listing.summary: Five bizarre ships, sprites that were first made as a joke but found themselves becoming real. These all represent post-collapse attempts at producing something viable from older hulls.
listing.aiSummary: Adds five bizarre salvage retrofit ships with concerning weapon mounts to Independent, Pirate, and Luddic Path fleets.
listing.partOfThreadTitle: [0.98] Ceres' Modyard - Dubious Engineering Ships & Vanilla Weapons Resprites

description: Five bizarre ships, sprites that were first made as a joke but found themselves becoming real. These all represent post-collapse attempts at producing something viable from older hulls. As salvage retrofits, you will find them in Independent and Pirate fleets and, rarely, for sale in Black Markets or on Independent worlds. The Righteous will also show up in Luddic Path fleets and bounties. Although they have fairly unassuming statlines, they do boast some seriously concerning weapon-mount arrangements - and are equally prone to overfluxing if equipped without due restraint.
